sources.title: TOMY Company to Hold BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025 on October 11 and 12, 2025
sources.snippet:
Title: TOMY Company to Hold BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025 on October 11 and 12, 2025
# TOMY Company to Hold BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025 on October 11 and 12, 2025. TOKYO, March 21, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- TOMY Company, Ltd., based in Katsushika Ward, Tokyo, will host the first-ever world tournament for the modern version of "bei-goma" spinning tops, the "BEYBLADE X" series, titled "BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025." This event will take place on October 11 (Sat.) and 12 (Sun.), 2025, at RED TOKYO TOWER. Images of the BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025. The BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025 is a competition where the top Blader title will be contested by the winners of competitions held around the world, including the United States, France, Singapore, and more. The championship will be held in Tokyo Tower, a symbolic location in Japan. It will be live streamed globally on BEYBLADE X's official YouTube channel, "BEYTUBE" () and on official BEYBLADE YouTube channels in each region, allowing the excitement of the competition to be experienced in real-time around the world. In BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025, we are looking forward to seeing winners of the regional tournaments gather in Japan, BEYBLADE's birthplace, to compete in heated battles. (\*2) BEYBLADE Day: The date was established based on the rules where players set their BEYBLADEs (tops) in a special launcher and shoot with the count of "3, 2, 1, Go Shoot!" TOMY chose March 21 as BEYBLADE Day to represent the countdown "3, 2, 1." (Registered as an association-recognized anniversary of the Japan Anniversary Association on March 21, 2023.). New line "CX (Custom Line)" and reissued product "BX-00 STARTER XENO XCALIBUR 3-60GF" to be released in Japan and Asia. "CX-01 STARTER DRANBRAVE S6-60V," a new product in the new "CX" line that allows users to customize the performance of their BEYBLADEs, and "BX-00 STARTER XENO XCALIBUR 3-60GF," a product that was a popular model from the 3rd generation "BEYBLADE BURST" series and reissued with the "BEYBLADE X" mechanism, will be released in 10 Asian countries and regions (Japan, South Korea, Taiwan region, Hong Kong SAR, Mainland China, Singapore, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand and Indonesia) on Saturday, March 29, 2025.
